decisions.reason: For the four unit-square sites the raw lifted determinant is zero because the squared-norm column equals x+y. This input-only quadruple is part of every augmented set, so the formerly unconditional augmented zero test rejected every candidate even in ordinary g=0 mode. Scoped the augmented zero tests to g=1; strict containment and exclusion of every noncollinear input circumcircle remain mandatory in both modes.
